args.command:
if [ -f /work/report.pdf ]; then python3 -c "
import sys
path = '/work/report.pdf'
try:
    from pypdf import PdfReader
    print(len(PdfReader(path).pages))
except Exception as e:
    try:
        import subprocess
        r = subprocess.run(['pdfinfo', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(r.stdout or r.stderr)
        print('ERR', e, file=sys.stderr)
    except Exception as e2:
        data = open(path, 'rb').read()
        print('count_approx', data.count(b'/Type /Page') - data.count(b'/Type /Pages'))
        print('size', len(data))
        print('pypdf', type(e).__name__, e)
        print('pdfinfo', type(e2).__name__, e2)
else:
    echo 'FILE_MISSING'
    ls -la /work 2>/dev/null || true
fi
